nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Midnight Recovery Botanical Cleansing Oil

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the oil rebalances and cleans thoroughly without leaving residue or excess grease, and some use it as a first step before an exfoliating scrub.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe softer, less tight and less flaky skin, though a few note it dried their skin out or required an immediate moisturizer follow-up.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say it handles both oily and dry days without causing breakouts or dryness, working well across seasons.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several say it causes no irritation, redness or stinging, while others report burning eyes, itching, redness or a reaction they attribute to the fragrance.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her fifties with combination/mature skin uses it nightly as part of a Kiehl's regimen without issue.

concerns.aging: No reviewer discusses anti-aging effects specifically; the product is used purely as a cleanser/makeup remover by mature-skin reviewers.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it does not strip natural oils and leaves skin soft rather than tight, especially in winter; a minority report it dried their skin out or left it feeling tight and needing immediate moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with redness-prone or sensitive skin report no irritation or redness after use, but others describe their face turning red, hot, or eyes becoming red and swollen.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits it with not disrupting the skin barrier while removing congestion; no other barrier-specific comments appear.
concerns.spots: Reviewers describe it pulling blackheads and congestion ('grit') from pores during massage, with one specifically citing removal of blackheads and clogged pores after a salicylic acid treatment.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers report fewer breakouts, clearer or blemish-free skin, and one credits it with reducing postpartum acne; however, others report new or worse breakouts (including a forehead breakout for one user) and one flags potentially pore-clogging ingredients as unsuitable for acne-prone skin.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers say it leaves no oily film and helps rebalance oil production; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Thin, runny texture, hard to dose
Rinses off cleanly with no residue

extraits.texte: This was okay for the first few days, although I didn't feel like it washed very clean - after about a week though I started breaking out terribly on my forehead, which rarely ever happens. I discontinued use and the breakout cleared quickly. Be careful if you have sensitive skin or are prone to breakouts.

After two uses, my under eye area feels like it's been burned and I've had to treat the area with soothing aloe for days now. And my eyes appear swollen and red from the irritation. This is definitely not for sensitive skin or sensitive eyes.

This product has been a GAME CHANGER for my skin! I have dry/ oily skin that is severely sensitive and acne prone (i actually didn't develop acne till my mid 20's). This cleansing oil removes my make up and washes my face with ZERO: irritation/ redness/ excessive oil/ flakiness left behind. I don't break out from this! I, my coworkers, friends, family and boyfriend have seen a DRASTIC change in the appearance of my skin! There has been a Complete 180° change in my skin!! Usually when I wash my face it becomes irritated, red and inflamed - THIS CLEANSING OIL LITERALLY LEAVES MY FACE THE EXACT OPPOSITE AFTER USE!!!! It is so gentle and effective! I have tried just about every product imaginable and seen results but they never last. I've been on literally EVERY acne antibiotic and NOTHING has been effective permanently. I literally use this 1 product plus lotion for a.m/p.m use - which is sort of unfathomable to me - and will CONTINUE to do so, for more than likely the rest of my life!!!!! This is worth EVERY penny!!!!! I honestly reccomend this to everyone that asks me what I've been doing to make my skin glow!!!! This Kiehl's product has actually made me feel good about myself when I look in the mirror and I find that it keeps me from putting on pounds of foundation / concealer!!!

My friend bought me a deluxe size of this as a gift, and I was like, "What do I even use this for?" ...then... I tried it, and now, I am a changed woman. I bought a full size now, and a little goes a long way. I use it after micellar water to remove most of my makeup, then this comes in and gets every little piece away. My skin feels so soft and clean afterwards, and possibly best thing ever, it rinses off so easily. There is no grimey residue at all. I have pretty dry skin and this works great, but my friend who gave it to me has oily skin and says it is his holy grail. Odd added bonus: my boyfriends likes how my face smells after using this.

I have super oily skin so was reluctant to try this. I can't believe how well it takes my makeup off! I use this and then an exfoliating scrub after if I need to. A little of this goes a long way. Makes your skin feel super clean and smooth.

extraits.titre: I bought this full size after trying a sample.
extraits.texte: I use this cleanser at night because it doesn't strip my face of the natural oils, but gets rid of makeup & dirt. I am 56 with combination skin and use it with a nighttime regimen of Kiehl's products.

I ordered this the first week of December and I use it at night along with my Eucerin redness relief face wash and it's perfect! I have really sensitive skin and prone to acne and I feel like this has actually helped my acne. I'm normally one to not spend a lot of money on products but this is worth the money!
